content:
I understand that reservation is an emotional issue for the Indian privileged castes as most of them suffer from a scarcity mentality and a superiority complex. 
The scarcity mentality makes them anxious that if Dalits/Adivasi receive better education and opportunities, the privileged castes lose out. The superiority complex makes them worry that they will lose their superiority over Dalits/Adivasi if they receive better opportunities. Therefore, most of them have opposed reservations since their inception. 
However, they must look rational while arguing, therefore, they offer arguments that appear rational. One of the points that they have always argued is that reservations are against the idea of merit. According to them not scoring as high as the privileged castes in the admission tets show that the Dalits/Adivasi lack merit and we would turn out to be useless in our chosen profession. 
They forget that once we get admission into a medical, engineering or law school, we need to pass all exams that rest of the students pass before we graduate. Most of us manage to pass the exams and do well in our chosen profession. 
I know several Dalits/Adivasi who are now senior lawyers or owners of top law firms or are general counsel or senior counsel in top companies, or are academics all over the world. 
I am also reminded of a story. A while back, when I visited my parents, I took my mother for health checkup at a top private hospital in Vadodara, Gujarat. 
As part of the check up, her eyes were also checked by an ophthalmologist. From his last name, he appeared to be of a privileged caste. 
He said to my mother, you seemed to have had a cataract surgery, who performed that surgery? My mother replied, it was Dr Parmar. 
The ophthalmologist immediately said, oh Dr Parmar, he is one of the best doctors. 
I know Dr Parmar as he is my distant relative. He studied in Gujarati medium State schools and got admission to a medical school with the help of reservations. Yet, he is now one of the best ophthalmologists. Is that not merit?
